description: This file declares the log_likelihood_ratio class used for representing and manipulating log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) in a communication system. It includes methods for saturated arithmetic, conversion, quantization, and other operations specific to LLRs, as well as constants and utility functions related to LLR processing.

classes.name: log_likelihood_ratio
classes.description: Represents log-likelihood ratio (LLR) values with saturated arithmetic, conversion, quantization, and other related operations.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Performs saturated addition of two LLRs.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Performs saturated subtraction of two LLRs.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Quantizes a float value into a discrete LLR value within the range.

methods.name: promotion_sum
methods.description: Performs a promotion sum, setting results beyond LLR_MAX to infinity.

methods.name: copysign
methods.description: Copies the sign from a number to an LLR.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of an LLR.

methods.name: soft_xor
methods.description: Computes the soft XOR of two LLRs using an approximation.

methods.name: norm_squared
methods.description: Calculates the squared Euclidean norm of a sequence of LLRs.

methods.name: dot_prod_sign
methods.description: Computes the dot product of LLRs and sign sequence.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Performs a saturated sum of two sequences of LLRs.
